_note: Join page. "status" is one of open, closed, upcoming and picks the page banner. The recruiting timeline steps and dates live in timelines.json ("recruiting"). Links left "" are hidden (the coffee-chat block is hidden until its URL is set).

banner.closed: Spring 2027 applications are closed. Join the e-list to hear about the next cycle.

recruiting.eligibility: Open to all Tufts undergraduates, of any major or class year. No prior finance experience is required: a training curriculum covers the fundamentals.
recruiting.application: A one-page resume and short-answer prompts. Interviews are in person and by invitation, with behavioral and technical questions.
recruiting.cadence: Teams meet Tuesdays and Fridays, with deadlines coordinated over Slack.
recruiting.coffeeChat: Want to learn more first? Sign up for a coffee chat with a board member.
